command.translateGitCommitAtLine: Translate Git Commit Message at Line
config.cache.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable in-memory and on-disk translation cache. Disable to always call the API (except when bypassing cache via refresh).
config.cache.maxDiskMB.markdownDescripti: Approximate maximum disk cache size under global storage (`cache/v2`).
config.cache.memoryEntries.markdownDescr: LRU size for in-memory cache entries.
config.detection.minLength.markdownDescr: Minimum character length before a fragment is considered for translation. Shorter text is skipped unless you use selection translate.
config.detection.reliableMinLength.markd: Below this length, language detection is treated as unreliable and the extension may skip translation unless confidence is high.
config.detection.skipPatterns.markdownDe: Regular expressions; matching fragments are never sent to the model. Applied together with [#linguaLens.privacy.exclude#](settings://linguaLens.privacy.exclude).
config.detection.strictChineseVariant.ma: When the target is `zh-CN` or `zh-TW`, do **not** translate text that is already in the other Chinese variant (e.g. skip Traditional when targeting Simplified).
config.detection.targetRatio.markdownDes: If this fraction of characters already looks like the target language, the fragment is skipped (reduces redundant API calls).
config.document.autoRefresh.markdownDesc: Automatically refresh the preview when the source document changes (experimental; may increase API usage).
config.document.batchSize.markdownDescri: Number of document segments per API batch when translating whole files.
config.document.codeLens.markdownDescrip: Show **Translate document** CodeLens at the top of Markdown/plain-text files.
config.document.forceTranslate.markdownD: When enabled, skip language detection for whole-document translation and send every segment to the model (may duplicate text already in the target language). Default follows [#linguaLens.detection.targetRatio#](settings://linguaLens.detection.targetRatio) like hover translation.
config.document.maxBatchChars.markdownDe: Maximum total source characters per document batch (splits batches with [#linguaLens.document.batchSize#](settings://linguaLens.document.batchSize)).
config.document.previewStyle.enum.append: Legacy style: translation appended after each block
config.document.previewStyle.enum.interl: Original block, blank line, then translation (lists/tables as whole blocks)
config.document.previewStyle.markdownDes: Layout of the `lingualens:` bilingual preview: interleaved blocks (recommended) or append translations after each block.
config.document.sideFileContent.markdown: Whether the side file contains only translated text or bilingual interleaved content.
config.document.sideFileNamePattern.mark: Filename pattern for **Generate translation file**; `${lang}` is replaced with the target language code.
config.enabled.markdownDescription: Turn LinguaLens on or off for this workspace or folder. When disabled, hover and selection translation stop; existing cache is kept.
config.glossary.maxTerms.markdownDescrip: Maximum glossary entries considered per translation after matching source text.
config.glossary.path.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative path to `.translate-glossary.json`. Up to [#linguaLens.glossary.maxTerms#](settings://linguaLens.glossary.maxTerms) terms are matched per request.
config.hover.comments.markdownDescriptio: Translate line, block, and doc comments in code files (tree-sitter with regex fallback).
config.hover.configKeys.markdownDescript: Translate YAML/TOML/JSON keys and values in configuration files.
config.hover.diagnostics.markdownDescrip: Append a translated diagnostic message when hovering compiler/linter squiggles.
config.hover.documents.markdownDescripti: Translate Markdown/plain-text paragraphs under the cursor (same segmentation as document preview). See [#linguaLens.document.previewStyle#](settings://linguaLens.document.previewStyle).
config.hover.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch for hover translation in editors. When off, [#linguaLens.hover.comments#](settings://linguaLens.hover.comments) and other hover options have no effect.
config.hover.extraDelayMs.markdownDescri: Delay after hover before calling the API (reduces calls while moving the pointer).
config.hover.gitCommitMessage.markdownDe: Translate Git inline blame commit messages at the end of the line.
config.hover.maxChars.markdownDescriptio: Maximum source characters per hover request; longer fragments are truncated.
config.hover.selection.markdownDescripti: Show translation when hovering over an active editor selection.
config.hover.showOriginal.markdownDescri: When enabled, show the original text above the translation in hover (debugging / comparison).
config.hover.strings.markdownDescription: Translate string literals and template strings in code.
config.hover.symbolDocs.markdownDescript: Append translated symbol documentation from other hover providers.
config.llm.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (must include `/v1`). API keys are stored per origin via **Set API Key**, not in settings. Quick access: [Settings panel](command:linguaLens.openSettingsPanel).
config.llm.extraBody.markdownDescription: Extra JSON merged into the chat/completions request body. Examples: DeepSeek / Doubao `{"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}}`; Qwen `{"enable_thinking":false}`.
config.llm.extraHeaders.markdownDescript: Extra HTTP headers added to every API request (e.g. custom auth proxies).
config.llm.jsonMode.enum.auto: JSON for document batches when supported
config.llm.jsonMode.markdownDescription: Force JSON response format for providers that support `response_format`. `auto` enables JSON for batch document translation.
config.llm.maxConcurrency.markdownDescri: Maximum concurrent in-flight API requests across hover, selection, and document batches.
config.llm.maxRetries.markdownDescriptio: Retries for transient network or 5xx errors before surfacing failure in the UI.
config.llm.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Upper bound on completion tokens per request (document batches may use the full limit).
config.llm.model.markdownDescription: Chat model id sent in API requests (e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`, `deepseek-chat`). Required for translation.
config.llm.stream.markdownDescription: Use SSE streaming for interactive requests (hover, selection). Document batch translation stays non-streaming. See also [#linguaLens.llm.extraBody#](settings://linguaLens.llm.extraBody).
config.llm.systemPrompt.markdownDescript: Additional system instructions appended to every translation prompt. Keep concise; glossary terms are injected separately via [#linguaLens.glossary.path#](settings://linguaLens.glossary.path).
config.llm.temperature.markdownDescripti: Sampling temperature for the chat API (lower = more deterministic translations).
config.llm.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: HTTP timeout per API request in milliseconds.
config.log.level.markdownDescription: Extension log verbosity in **LinguaLens: Show Log**. Use `debug` or `trace` to diagnose hover pipeline issues.
config.markdown.frontmatterFields.markdo: YAML/TOML frontmatter field names whose **natural-language** values are translated in document preview and hover. Set to `[]` to disable. Keys like `name` and URLs are always preserved.
config.parser.maxFileSizeKB.markdownDesc: Files larger than this are not parsed for tree-sitter hover extraction.
config.privacy.allowedSchemes.markdownDe: Document URI schemes allowed for translation (virtual/notebook schemes enable limited support).
config.privacy.exclude.markdownDescripti: Glob patterns for files that LinguaLens will not read or translate (e.g. `.env`, keys, `node_modules`).

config.selection.output.enum.auto: Notification for short text, new document when long
config.selection.output.markdownDescript: Where to show selection translation results. `notification` is fastest; `document` opens a scratch buffer when output is long.
config.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescrip: Show the **译** status bar entry that opens the LinguaLens quick menu.
config.targetLanguage.markdownDescriptio: Target language for translations. Detection skips text that already matches the target (see [#linguaLens.detection.strictChineseVariant#](settings://linguaLens.detection.strictChineseVariant)).
